import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Get all station coordinates
stations_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry as geom
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(stations_query, engine)
print(f"Number of stations: {len(stations_df)}")
print(stations_df[['id', 'name_en']].to_string(index=False))

# Step 2: Compute Voronoi tessellation, clip to bounding box, and calculate areas
voronoi_query = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, ST_SetSRID(coordinate::geometry, 4326) AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_Extent(geom) AS extent FROM station_points
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.id AS station_id,
        sp.name_en,
        ST_Intersection(
            (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(sp.geom), 16))).geom,
            (SELECT ST_Expand(extent, 0.1) FROM bbox)
        ) AS cell
    FROM station_points sp
    GROUP BY sp.id, sp.name_en, sp.geom
)
SELECT 
    station_id,
    name_en,
    ROUND(ST_Area(cell::geography) / 1000000.0, 1) AS area_km2
FROM voronoi
WHERE cell IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY area_km2 ASC
""")

voronoi_results = pd.read_sql(voronoi_query, engine)
print("\nVoronoi cell areas (km²):")
print(voronoi_results.to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd

SELECT id, name_en, coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id

print(f"Found {len(stations_df)} stations")
print(stations_df[['id', 'name_en']].to_string(index=False))

# Step 2: Compute Voronoi tessellation clipped to bounding box
voronoi_query = text("""
WITH bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(coordinate::geometry)) AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT (gv).path[0] AS station_id, (gv).geom AS geom
    FROM (
        SELECT ST_VoronoiPolygons(
            ST_Collect(coordinate::geometry),
            0,
            (SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(coordinate::geometry)) FROM air_quality_station)
        ) AS gv
        FROM air_quality_station
    ) sub
)
SELECT 
    aqs.id AS station_id,
    aqs.name_en AS station_name,
    ST_Area(ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.geom)::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2
FROM voronoi v
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON v.station_id = aqs.id
CROSS JOIN bbox b
WHERE ST_Intersects(v.geom, b.geom)
ORDER BY area_km2 ASC
""")

voronoi_results = pd.read_sql(voronoi_query, engine)
print("\nVoronoi cell areas (km²):")
print(voronoi_results.to_string(index=False))

print(f"\nSmallest cell: {smallest['station_name']} with area {smallest['area_km2']:.1f} km²")
